newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures wander at mixed levels late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures wander at mixed levels late.

text.p: June 4 - U.S. debt futures wandered at mixed levels in light late trading. Brokers said technicals for long and short ends stayed skewed to upside, but even professionals seeking rallies to sell stayed sidelined before Friday's jobs data. In morning, hedging from Brazil Brady swap pressured Sept bonds, which recovered when hedge sales were done, they said.
